research_routes.source: Arjmandi, The LLM Proposes, the Executive Disposes, arXiv:2608.04066
research_routes.projection: A deterministic executive can own belief/commitment while an LLM files typed proposals; verification can be structural and pre-registered rather than trusting agent self-report.
research_routes.deduplication: Generic proposal-versus-commit separation is no longer a defensible standalone RAKL novelty claim.
research_routes.rakl_consequence: Keep proposer non-authority as a core invariant but move novelty toward scientific multi-axis authority, local-view synthesis, saturation and governed recursion.

research_routes.source: Evidence-Graded Decision Authorization for Safe Clinical AI, medRxiv 10.64898/2026.05.19.26353565
research_routes.projection: LLM assertions/actions can be formally licensed according to evidence grade, separating information supply from inferential governance.
research_routes.deduplication: Evidence-gated claim authorization is prior art and cannot be presented as uniquely RAKL.
research_routes.rakl_consequence: Distinguish a single evidence-grade gate from a partially ordered scientific authority state with separate mechanism, identification and decision coordinates.

research_routes.source: Ren, Evidence-Grounded Verified Agentic Reasoning, arXiv:2607.12650
research_routes.projection: A Lean kernel can be the sole minter of Verified claims whose proof chains descend from attested tool calls, while unsupported outputs become explicit abstentions.
research_routes.deduplication: Strict evidence-to-verified-status gating and formal abstention are prior art.
research_routes.rakl_consequence: RAKL should use formal verification where appropriate but claim only the broader scientific authority composition and scoped cross-layer non-escalation.

research_routes.source: Xu, Li and Sheng, GAVEL, Findings ACL 2026, doi:10.18653/v1/2026.findings-acl.1789
research_routes.projection: Atomic subclaims can be contractually bound to exact evidence units and audited by deterministic citation/span validation before a judge decides sufficiency.
research_routes.deduplication: Atomic claim-to-evidence binding and mechanized citation checks are strong prior art for RAKL's provenance fiber.
research_routes.rakl_consequence: META_N015 should benchmark scientific evidence packets beyond citation correctness: support scope, contradiction coverage, authority layer and omission.

research_routes.route: agent evidence tracing and execution provenance
research_routes.source: Wang et al., From Agent Traces to Trust, arXiv:2606.04990
research_routes.projection: Evidence and execution provenance can connect retrieval, tool outputs, memory, intermediate claims, actions and final answers, shifting evaluation beyond final-answer accuracy.
research_routes.deduplication: Generic provenance-bearing agent traces are not a RAKL novelty claim.
research_routes.rakl_consequence: The paper must specify which scientific authority transition each provenance edge can or cannot license.

research_routes.source: Pidlisnyi, Monotonic Narrowing for Agent Authority, SSRN 2026
research_routes.projection: Operational agent capabilities can be represented under scoped delegation with a monotonic-narrowing invariant.
research_routes.deduplication: Partial-order/scoped authority concepts exist in operational agent governance, so RAKL should not claim order theory itself as novel.
research_routes.rakl_consequence: The open contribution is specifically scientific epistemic authority across grounding, representation, mechanism, identification and decision, not generic agent permission lattices.

retained_semantic_objects.meaning: Scientific authority is represented as partially ordered axis-specific certificates rather than a scalar confidence or one total authority ladder.
Incompatible assumptions/scopes may make joins scientifically invalid; the framework must preserve incomparability/obstruction instead of forcing a least upper bound.
Evidence validators authorize only the scientific coordinate they establish; observational, decision, mechanism and identification authority cannot substitute for one another.
Fresh 2026 work makes generic proposer-versus-executive/evidence-gate separation explicit prior art, narrowing T002 from novelty candidate to RAKL invariant only.
